title.zh: 官方部署：先跑通一条可复现链路
title.en: Official setup: reproduce one known-good path

outcome.zh: 选对 FL2VA 或 Ref2VA 权重，完成环境检查并复现官方样例。
outcome.en: Choose the right FL2VA or Ref2VA weights, check the environment, and reproduce an official sample.

audience.zh: 第一次本地部署 H3 的开发者。
audience.en: Developers running H3 locally for the first time.

hardware.zh: 以官方 README 当前支持的 NVIDIA 环境为准；低显存用户先看量化路线。
hardware.en: Use the NVIDIA environment currently documented by the official README; low-VRAM users should start with a quantized path.

zh: Git、Git LFS 与足够磁盘空间
已阅读模型许可
能够访问官方权重
en: Git, Git LFS, and enough disk space
The model license has been reviewed
Access to the official weights

zh: 先确认任务类型和对应权重，不混用 FL2VA 与 Ref2VA。
按官方 README 选择 SGLang、vLLM、Diffusers 或 ComfyUI 路线。
先复现官方固定样例，再替换 Prompt 与参考素材。
en: Choose the task family and matching weights; do not mix FL2VA and Ref2VA.
Pick SGLang, vLLM, Diffusers, or ComfyUI from the current official README.
Reproduce a fixed official sample before replacing prompts or references.

zh: 模型、节点和显存要求会变化，执行前重新核验最新 README。
en: Models, nodes, and memory requirements evolve; recheck the latest README before running.

title.zh: NVIDIA + ComfyUI：从单段到导演工作流
title.en: NVIDIA + ComfyUI: from one shot to director workflows

outcome.zh: 完成原生 H3 工作流，再按需加入 Turbo、续接、音频或导演节点。
outcome.en: Run the native H3 workflow, then add Turbo, chaining, audio, or director nodes only as needed.

audience.zh: 希望用节点图控制多模态素材与音画生成的用户。
audience.en: Users who want node-graph control over multimodal inputs and audio-video generation.

hardware.zh: NVIDIA GPU；显存不足时优先量化、剪枝或云端 GPU。
hardware.en: An NVIDIA GPU; use quantized, pruned, or cloud paths when VRAM is limited.

zh: 可运行的 ComfyUI
官方 H3 权重与双 VAE
先准备 5 秒固定测试素材
en: A working ComfyUI installation
Official H3 weights and both VAEs
A fixed five-second test input

zh: 先导入官方原生工作流并确认模型路径。
固定 seed、Prompt 与素材得到基线结果。
一次只增加一个加速器或扩展节点，并与基线 A/B。
en: Import the native workflow and verify every model path.
Create a baseline with fixed seed, prompt, and media.
Add one accelerator or extension at a time and compare against the baseline.

zh: Turbo、Spectrum、Cache 等优化不要默认叠加。
en: Do not assume Turbo, Spectrum, and cache optimizations stack safely.

title.zh: Mac 原生运行：纯 C + Metal
title.en: Native Mac inference: pure C + Metal

outcome.zh: 不依赖 Python、PyTorch 或 ComfyUI，在 Apple Silicon 上完成 H3 生成。
outcome.en: Generate with H3 on Apple Silicon without Python, PyTorch, or ComfyUI.

audience.zh: 愿意使用命令行的 Apple Silicon Mac 用户。
audience.en: Apple Silicon users comfortable with a command line.

hardware.zh: Apple Silicon Mac；性能和内存占用以 h3.c 当前实测为准。
hardware.en: An Apple Silicon Mac; use the current h3.c benchmarks for performance and memory expectations.

zh: Xcode Command Line Tools
FFmpeg 与 FFprobe 在 PATH
官方 Hugging Face 权重
en: Xcode Command Line Tools
FFmpeg and FFprobe on PATH
Official Hugging Face weights

zh: 编译 h3.c。
检查模型目录和 Metal 设备。
进入交互模式，用 !first、!last 或 !ref-image 设置条件后生成。
en: Build h3.c.
Inspect the model directory and Metal device.
Enter interactive mode and set !first, !last, or !ref-image before generating.

zh: 项目更新很快；命令、权重布局和支持功能以当前 README 为准。
en: The project evolves quickly; use the current README for commands, weight layout, and supported features.

title.zh: Prompt 与 Agent Skill：先把镜头写清楚
title.en: Prompt and Agent Skill: direct the shot before rendering

outcome.zh: 让 Agent 按镜头、动作、对白与环境声组织 H3 Prompt，并保留人工确认。
outcome.en: Have an agent structure H3 prompts around shots, action, dialogue, and environmental audio while keeping human review.

audience.zh: 希望在 Claude、Codex 等 Agent 中复用 H3 提示词方法的创作者。
audience.en: Creators who want reusable H3 prompt direction inside agents such as Claude or Codex.

hardware.zh: 写 Prompt 不需要 GPU；最终生成环境另行准备。
hardware.en: Prompt writing needs no GPU; prepare a separate generation environment.

zh: 支持 Skill 的 Agent
明确的视频目标、时长和输入素材
愿意在渲染前核对 Prompt
en: An agent that supports Skills
A clear video goal, duration, and input set
A human review before rendering

zh: 安装官方 h3-prompt-writing Skill。
先告诉 Agent 目标、素材、时长和硬性限制。
让 Agent 输出镜头、对白与声音结构，核对后再交给生成工作流。
en: Install the official h3-prompt-writing Skill.
Give the agent the goal, media, duration, and hard constraints first.
Review its shot, dialogue, and sound structure before sending it to a generation workflow.

zh: Skill 负责组织，不应猜测缺失素材、参数或最新节点用法。
en: The Skill structures the task; it must not guess missing media, parameters, or current node behavior.

title.zh: 从零装机到第一条带声视频
title.en: From a clean machine to the first video with audio

outcome.zh: 建立一条可复现的本地 H3 部署与 Prompt 起步流程。
outcome.en: Build a reproducible local H3 setup and prompt-writing baseline.

audience.zh: 第一次部署 H3 的 NVIDIA 用户。
audience.en: NVIDIA users deploying H3 for the first time.

hardware.zh: NVIDIA GPU；具体显存与软件版本按原帖文章及官方 README 复核。
hardware.en: An NVIDIA GPU; recheck VRAM and software versions against the source article and official README.

zh: 系统和显卡驱动可用
准备模型下载空间
能运行 ComfyUI
en: A working OS and GPU driver
Enough storage for model downloads
A runnable ComfyUI installation

zh: 按原帖文章准备依赖与模型目录。
先复现文中的带声视频基线。
再按官方 Prompt 语法替换镜头、对白和环境声。
en: Prepare dependencies and model directories from the source article.
Reproduce its audio-video baseline first.
Then replace shot, dialogue, and ambience using the official prompt syntax.

zh: 执行前再次核验官方 README；不要把文章中的旧版本号当成永久要求。
en: Recheck the official README; do not treat versions in the article as permanent requirements.

title.zh: 四个 H3 仓库怎么组合使用
title.en: How four essential H3 repositories fit together

outcome.zh: 把官方 Skill、Turbo、Motion Context 和音频工作流放进一条清晰路线。
outcome.en: Place the official Skill, Turbo, Motion Context, and audio workflows into one clear path.

audience.zh: 已经跑通基础 H3，正在选择扩展能力的用户。
audience.en: Users who have the base model working and are choosing extensions.

hardware.zh: 取决于选中的本地推理路线。
hardware.en: Depends on the selected local inference route.

zh: 先能运行原生 H3
明确当前瓶颈是 Prompt、速度、时长还是音频
en: A working native H3 setup
A clear bottleneck: prompting, speed, duration, or audio

zh: 先用官方 Skill 建立 Prompt 基线。
需要速度时单独测试 Turbo。
需要跨段连续性或精细音频时，再分别加入 Motion Context 或 T8。
en: Start with the official Skill for a prompt baseline.
Test Turbo alone when speed is the constraint.
Add Motion Context or T8 separately for continuity or detailed audio control.

zh: 优化器并非越多越好；每次只加一个并固定素材对比。
en: More optimizers are not automatically better; add one at a time with fixed inputs.

title.zh: Attention、人物 LoRA 与低显存路线补全
title.en: Attention backends, character LoRA, and low-VRAM paths

outcome.zh: 按需求补上更稳参数、Attention 后端、人物 LoRA 或低显存方案。
outcome.en: Add steadier settings, an attention backend, character LoRA, or a low-VRAM path based on the actual need.

audience.zh: 已经有基础工作流，想针对性能或角色一致性继续优化的用户。
audience.en: Users with a base workflow who want performance or character-consistency improvements.

hardware.zh: NVIDIA；不同后端与量化组合需单独测试。
hardware.en: NVIDIA; each backend and quantization combination needs separate testing.

zh: 稳定的原生基线
固定 seed、Prompt 与输入素材
en: A stable native baseline
A fixed seed, prompt, and input set

zh: 先记录原生基线的速度、显存和质量。
每次只切换一个 Attention、LoRA 或量化变量。
保留对比结果，再决定是否进入正式工作流。
en: Record baseline speed, VRAM, and quality.
Change one attention, LoRA, or quantization variable at a time.
Keep the comparison before promoting the choice into production.

zh: 原帖是路线总结；具体参数必须回到各项目最新 README 核验。
en: The post is a route summary; verify exact parameters in each project's latest README.

title.zh: Context-IR 增强 Prompt，再回本地生成
title.en: Enhance a prompt with Context-IR, then render locally

outcome.zh: 把情绪意图拆成动作、运镜和声音设计，再交给本地 H3。
outcome.en: Turn emotional intent into action, camera direction, and sound design before local H3 generation.

audience.zh: 首帧生成结果动作不够细腻的用户。
audience.en: Users whose first-frame generations lack nuanced action.

hardware.zh: 云端 Context-IR + 本地 H3 环境。
hardware.en: Cloud Context-IR plus a local H3 environment.

zh: 原始 Prompt
首帧图
可运行的本地 H3 Base
en: An original prompt
A first-frame image
A working local H3 Base setup

zh: 把原 Prompt 与首帧交给 Context-IR。
核对返回文本是否忠于原意和素材。
用增强 Prompt 在本地生成 768p 测试并与原始版本对比。
en: Send the original prompt and first frame to Context-IR.
Review whether the returned text stays faithful to the intent and media.
Generate a 768p local test and compare it with the unenhanced version.

zh: Context-IR 是云端环节；不要上传无权共享或敏感素材。
en: Context-IR is a cloud step; do not upload sensitive media or assets you cannot share.

title.zh: 用参考视频重做同一表演的机位
title.en: Generate new camera angles from one performance

outcome.zh: 在保持场景与表演连续的前提下切换 POV。
outcome.en: Switch point of view while preserving the scene and performance.

audience.zh: 需要补拍机位或多角度剪辑的创作者。
audience.en: Creators who need coverage or alternate angles for editing.

hardware.zh: 支持 H3 Ref2VA / 视频参考的环境。
hardware.en: An H3 Ref2VA or video-reference workflow.

zh: 清晰的参考视频
明确的新机位描述
en: A clear reference video
A precise description of the new camera position

zh: 把原视频作为动作和表演参考。
Prompt 只改变机位、焦段或视角，保留场景与动作约束。
生成多个短镜头后检查身份、动作和时序一致性。
en: Use the original video as motion and performance reference.
Change only camera position, lens, or POV while preserving scene and action constraints.
Generate short alternatives and check identity, motion, and timing continuity.

zh: 不要声称像素级复刻；快速运动和遮挡仍可能漂移。
en: Do not expect pixel-level reconstruction; fast motion and occlusion can still drift.

title.zh: 从分镜关键帧生成风格统一的预告片
title.en: Turn storyboard frames into a consistent trailer

outcome.zh: 用最终影片关键帧与镜头描述逐镜生成，再组合成预告片。
outcome.en: Generate shot by shot from final-film frames and shot descriptions, then assemble a trailer.

audience.zh: 已有分镜或成片关键帧的电影与广告创作者。
audience.en: Film and advertising creators with storyboards or final-film frames.

hardware.zh: 支持图像参考的 H3 工作流。
hardware.en: An H3 image-reference workflow.

zh: 按镜头切出的参考帧
每个镜头的动作与运镜描述
剪辑时间线
en: Reference frames split by shot
Action and camera direction for each shot
An editing timeline

zh: 从最终视觉中提取每个镜头的参考帧。
逐镜输入参考帧与镜头描述，固定风格约束。
筛选结果并按节奏剪辑，最后统一声音与色彩。
en: Extract one reference frame for every intended shot.
Generate each shot with its frame and description while keeping style constraints fixed.
Select takes, edit to rhythm, and finish sound and color consistently.

zh: 镜头间一致性仍需人工挑片与后期，不应一次生成整条预告。
en: Cross-shot consistency still needs curation and post; do not expect one-pass trailer generation.

title.zh: RTX 3060 + Turbo LoRA 制作一分钟预告片
title.en: Build a one-minute trailer on RTX 3060 with Turbo LoRA

outcome.zh: 把多张既有图片转成多个短镜头，再剪成一分钟预告片。
outcome.en: Animate an existing image set into short shots and edit them into a one-minute trailer.

audience.zh: 12GB 显存、已有概念图或分镜图的创作者。
audience.en: Creators with 12GB VRAM and an existing concept-art or storyboard set.

hardware.zh: RTX 3060 12GB、24GB 系统内存（原帖实测环境）。
hardware.en: RTX 3060 12GB and 24GB system memory, as reported by the source.

zh: 一组风格统一的图片
可运行的 Turbo LoRA 工作流
视频剪辑工具
en: A style-consistent image set
A working Turbo LoRA workflow
A video editor

zh: 按镜头顺序整理图片与动作描述。
用 Turbo LoRA 逐张生成短片，不在单次生成中追求整分钟。
挑选结果并在剪辑软件中完成节奏与声音。
en: Order the images and action notes by shot.
Generate short clips with Turbo LoRA instead of chasing a one-minute single pass.
Select takes and finish pacing and sound in an editor.

zh: 一分钟是后期拼接结果，不是 H3 单次生成时长。
en: The one-minute result is edited from shots; it is not a single H3 generation.

title.zh: Maestro 六步 Turbo：先以速度换预览
title.en: Maestro six-step Turbo: trade detail for iteration speed

outcome.zh: 在 Maestro 中用六步蒸馏 LoRA 快速预览 H3 结果。
outcome.en: Use a six-step distilled LoRA in Maestro for fast H3 previews.

audience.zh: 使用 Maestro，希望缩短试错时间的本地用户。
audience.en: Local Maestro users who want shorter iteration cycles.

hardware.zh: 取决于 Maestro 与所选 H3 权重。
hardware.en: Depends on Maestro and the selected H3 weights.

zh: 可运行的 Maestro H3 工作流
Turbo / Distilled LoRA
固定基线素材
en: A working Maestro H3 workflow
A Turbo or distilled LoRA
A fixed baseline input

zh: 先在原生模式保存基线。
切到六步 Turbo 并保持其他参数不变。
把 Turbo 用于选镜和构图，重要成片再比较更高步数。
en: Save a native-mode baseline first.
Switch to six-step Turbo without changing other variables.
Use Turbo for shot selection and compare higher steps for important finals.

zh: 原作者明确提醒结果仍可能粗糙；速度提升不等于同等质量。
en: The source explicitly notes rougher results; faster does not mean equivalent quality.

title.zh: Maestro 低显存：Pruned 20B + Turbo
title.en: Low-VRAM Maestro: pruned 20B plus Turbo

outcome.zh: 用剪枝 20B、六步 Turbo 与可选 First Block Cache 降低显存压力。
outcome.en: Reduce VRAM pressure with the pruned 20B model, six-step Turbo, and optional First Block Cache.

audience.zh: 显存不足以舒适运行全量模型的 Maestro 用户。
audience.en: Maestro users who cannot comfortably run the full model.

hardware.zh: 低显存 NVIDIA 环境；实际下限以 Maestro 当前文档为准。
hardware.en: A lower-VRAM NVIDIA setup; use current Maestro documentation for the actual minimum.

zh: Maestro 新版
Pruned 20B 权重
Turbo 权重
en: A current Maestro release
Pruned 20B weights
Turbo weights

zh: 先选择 Pruned 20B 与六步 Turbo。
完成固定素材基线并记录显存。
仍需优化时再单独打开 First Block Cache 并检查画质。
en: Select the pruned 20B model and six-step Turbo.
Run a fixed-input baseline and record VRAM.
Enable First Block Cache only if still needed, then inspect quality again.

zh: Cache 是额外变量，不能和 Turbo 一起直接宣称无损。
en: Cache is another variable; do not claim lossless stacking with Turbo without testing.

title.zh: RTX 3060 的 Turbo LoRA 前后实测
title.en: Before-and-after Turbo LoRA benchmark on RTX 3060

outcome.zh: 在同一台 3060 上用固定分辨率和时长比较原生与 Turbo。
outcome.en: Compare native and Turbo runs at fixed resolution and duration on the same RTX 3060.

audience.zh: 想用真实生成时间评估 Turbo 收益的 12GB 用户。
audience.en: 12GB users who want a measured view of Turbo gains.

hardware.zh: RTX 3060 12GB、64GB RAM、Windows 11（原帖实测）。
hardware.en: RTX 3060 12GB, 64GB RAM, and Windows 11, as reported by the source.

zh: v4 step600 EMA Turbo LoRA
en: A fixed 1056×608 ten-second test
The v4 step600 EMA Turbo LoRA

zh: 先跑原生基线并记录时间。
只加入指定 Turbo LoRA，保持素材与输出设置不变。
比较耗时、画面、声音与运动稳定性。
en: Run a native baseline and record its time.
Add only the specified Turbo LoRA while keeping input and output settings fixed.
Compare time, image quality, audio, and motion stability.

zh: 原帖时间只代表该机器与设置，不能外推到所有环境。
en: The reported times apply only to that machine and configuration.

title.zh: Mac Studio 上用 Phosphene 跑 Turbo
title.en: Run H3 Turbo on Mac Studio with Phosphene

outcome.zh: 在 Apple Silicon 上用较少步数把 5 秒生成从约 20 分钟压到约 8 分钟。
outcome.en: Use fewer steps on Apple Silicon to reduce a five-second run from about 20 minutes to about eight in the reported setup.

audience.zh: 希望用图形化工具体验 Mac H3 Turbo 的用户。
audience.en: Mac users who want a graphical H3 Turbo path.

hardware.zh: Mac Studio M4 64GB（原帖实测）。
hardware.en: Mac Studio M4 with 64GB memory, as reported by the source.

zh: 支持 H3 的 Phosphene 版本
Turbo 模式权重
短片固定测试
en: A Phosphene version with H3 support
Turbo-mode weights
A fixed short-clip test

zh: 先在关闭 Turbo 时生成基线。
打开 Turbo 并保持 Prompt 与素材不变。
把快速结果用于迭代，重要镜头再回到高质量设置。
en: Generate a baseline with Turbo disabled.
Enable Turbo while keeping prompt and media unchanged.
Use the faster result for iteration and return to quality settings for important shots.

zh: 原作者报告 Turbo 运动和形变仍较弱，关闭 Turbo 质量更好。
en: The source reports weaker motion and distortion under Turbo, with better quality when disabled.

title.zh: 本地配置不够：租 GPU + 预装 ComfyUI
title.en: When local hardware is short: rent a GPU with a ComfyUI image

outcome.zh: 不改本机环境，快速完成一次 H3 云端试跑。
outcome.en: Run one H3 cloud test without rebuilding the local machine.

audience.zh: 本地显存不足、只想先验证效果的用户。
audience.en: Users with limited local VRAM who want to validate results first.

hardware.zh: 原帖建议 5090 + 32GB；实际选择需按平台镜像与预算核对。
hardware.en: The post suggests a 5090 plus 32GB; verify the actual instance image and cost with the provider.

zh: 可信的 GPU 云平台账号
预装 ComfyUI + H3 的镜像
明确的费用上限
en: An account on a trusted GPU provider
A ComfyUI image that includes H3
A firm cost limit

zh: 选择带 H3 模型的 ComfyUI 镜像。
启动后先检查模型路径和公网访问设置。
完成短片测试后停止实例并确认账单。
en: Choose a ComfyUI image that includes the H3 model.
Check model paths and public-access settings after launch.
Stop the instance after a short test and confirm billing.

zh: 云平台会持续计费；不要上传敏感素材，使用后及时关机。
en: Cloud instances keep billing; avoid sensitive media and shut the instance down promptly.

title.zh: 双时钟采样器：分别控制视频与音频步数
title.en: Dual-clock sampling: separate video and audio step counts

outcome.zh: 在 ComfyUI 中分别控制音画采样，并与加速 LoRA 做受控对比。
outcome.en: Control video and audio sampling separately in ComfyUI and compare it carefully with an acceleration LoRA.

audience.zh: 对声音质量、同步和生成速度都敏感的进阶用户。
audience.en: Advanced users balancing sound quality, sync, and generation speed.

hardware.zh: 能运行 H3 ComfyUI 的 NVIDIA 环境。
hardware.en: An NVIDIA environment capable of running H3 in ComfyUI.

zh: T8 音画节点
官方 H3 工作流
固定音画测试 Prompt
en: The T8 audio-video nodes
A native H3 workflow
A fixed audio-video test prompt

zh: 安装 T8 节点并先跑稳定基础链路。
分别调整视频与音频步数，记录耗时和同步。
需要时再加入加速 LoRA，并与未加速基线对比。
en: Install the T8 nodes and run the stable base path first.
Adjust video and audio steps separately while recording time and sync.
Add an acceleration LoRA only if needed and compare against the native baseline.

zh: 社区宣称的速度提升需在自己的机器上复测；实验节点与稳定节点要分开。
en: Re-test community speed claims on your own hardware and keep experimental nodes separate from stable ones.

title.zh: ComfyUI 原生 H3：四种输入模式怎么选
title.en: Native H3 in ComfyUI: choose the right input mode

outcome.zh: 根据文字、首尾帧或多模态参考选择正确工作流。
outcome.en: Choose the right workflow for text, keyframes, or multimodal references.

audience.zh: 第一次在 ComfyUI 中看到 H3 多种工作流的用户。
audience.en: Users seeing H3's multiple ComfyUI workflows for the first time.

hardware.zh: 以 ComfyUI 与官方 H3 当前文档为准。
hardware.en: Follow current ComfyUI and official H3 documentation.

zh: 可运行的 ComfyUI
H3 模型与 VAE
明确输入素材类型
en: A working ComfyUI installation
H3 model and VAEs
A known input-media type

zh: 只有 Prompt 时选文生视频。
需要开场或收尾控制时选首帧、尾帧或首尾帧路线。
需要保持人物、动作或声音时选 Ref2VA，并按顺序引用素材。
en: Use text-to-video when the prompt is the only input.
Use first, last, or first-and-last frame control for boundaries.
Use Ref2VA to carry a subject, motion, or voice, with references in the documented order.

zh: 不同输入模式对应的权重和接线不同，不要仅替换输入端口。
en: Input modes use different weights and wiring; do not merely swap input ports.

title.zh: RTX 4080 16GB：Pruned + INT8 低显存部署
title.en: RTX 4080 16GB: pruned plus INT8 low-VRAM setup

outcome.zh: 在 16GB 显存上跑通 10 秒本地 H3 测试。
outcome.en: Run a ten-second local H3 test within 16GB VRAM.

audience.zh: 4080 16GB 或相近显存、需要低显存路线的用户。
audience.en: Users around 16GB VRAM who need a reduced-memory path.

hardware.zh: RTX 4080 16GB（原帖实测）；约 10 分钟生成 10 秒视频。
hardware.en: RTX 4080 16GB as reported by the source; roughly ten minutes for a ten-second clip.

zh: ComfyUI 原生工作流
匹配的 pruned 与 INT8 权重
正确模型目录
en: The native ComfyUI workflow
Matching pruned and INT8 weights
Correct model directories

zh: 严格按权重说明放置模型，不混用版本。
先导入固定 10 秒测试工作流。
确认显存与输出后再提高分辨率或时长。
en: Place models exactly as documented and do not mix versions.
Import a fixed ten-second test workflow first.
Confirm VRAM and output before increasing resolution or duration.

zh: 量化与剪枝可能影响质量；先复现，再做画质判断。
en: Quantization and pruning may affect quality; reproduce first, then evaluate.

title.zh: 4-bit + DiffSynth：最低 8GB 显存路线
title.en: 4-bit plus DiffSynth: an 8GB-VRAM route

outcome.zh: 通过 4-bit 量化与显存自适应推理在更小显存上运行 H3。
outcome.en: Run H3 on smaller GPUs through 4-bit quantization and VRAM-adaptive inference.

audience.zh: 8GB 显存或希望在 Mac 上尝试量化 H3 的用户。
audience.en: Users with 8GB VRAM or those testing a quantized H3 path on Mac.

hardware.zh: 最低 8GB VRAM 为来源公布下限；实际速度和可用模式需复核。
hardware.en: The source reports an 8GB minimum; verify actual speed and supported modes.

zh: DiffSynth-Studio
匹配的 4-bit H3 权重
足够系统内存与磁盘
en: DiffSynth-Studio
Matching 4-bit H3 weights
Enough system memory and storage

zh: 从来源页面确认当前 4-bit 模型与 DiffSynth 版本。
按可用显存启用自适应推理设置。
先生成低时长基线，再逐步测试分辨率与模式。
en: Confirm the current 4-bit model and DiffSynth version from the source.
Enable VRAM-adaptive inference for the available memory.
Start with a short baseline, then test resolution and modes gradually.

zh: 低显存可运行不等于速度快；量化质量与原生模型不同。
en: Running in low VRAM does not imply speed, and quantized quality differs from native weights.

title.zh: 用 AI Toolkit 训练 H3 Ref2VA LoRA
title.en: Train a MiniMax H3 Ref2VA LoRA with AI Toolkit

outcome.zh: 为视频到视频任务准备数据，并完成一次可审计的 Ref2VA LoRA 训练。
outcome.en: Prepare a video-to-video dataset and run an auditable Ref2VA LoRA training experiment.

audience.zh: 有训练经验、数据和高显存 GPU 的开发者。
audience.en: Developers with training experience, data, and a high-memory GPU.

hardware.zh: 高显存 NVIDIA GPU；具体要求以 AI Toolkit 与当前 H3 训练文档为准。
hardware.en: A high-memory NVIDIA GPU; use current AI Toolkit and H3 training docs for exact requirements.

zh: 有权使用的视频数据
AI Toolkit 当前版本
基础模型许可已核对
en: Video data you are allowed to use
A current AI Toolkit release
The base-model license has been reviewed

zh: 把目标能力定义成可验证的数据对。
按教程配置 Ref2VA LoRA，而不是直接套用图像 LoRA 参数。
先跑短训练和固定验证集，再决定是否扩大训练。
en: Define the target behavior as verifiable data pairs.
Configure a Ref2VA LoRA from the tutorial instead of copying image-LoRA settings.
Run a short training and fixed validation set before scaling up.

zh: 训练会消耗大量算力；数据版权和模型许可必须先确认。
en: Training is compute-intensive; confirm dataset rights and model licensing first.

title.zh: H3 WebUI：Motion Context + 内置升频
title.en: H3 WebUI: Motion Context plus built-in upscaling

outcome.zh: 通过 Motion Context 把短片续接到最长约一分钟，并在导出前升频。
outcome.en: Chain short clips toward roughly one minute with Motion Context and upscale before export.

audience.zh: 希望用 WebUI 而不是手接 ComfyUI 图的用户。
audience.en: Users who prefer a WebUI over manually wiring a ComfyUI graph.

hardware.zh: Apple Silicon / 项目当前支持环境；以 WebUI 文档为准。
hardware.en: Apple Silicon or the environments currently supported by the WebUI.

zh: H3 WebUI 1.4 或更新版本
短片分段计划
足够的生成和升频时间
en: H3 WebUI 1.4 or newer
A short-clip segment plan
Enough time for generation and upscaling

zh: 先用 5 秒 720p 验证基础生成。
开启 Motion Context 并分段生成，逐段检查接缝。
最后再启用内置升频，不把升频问题混入生成调参。
en: Validate a five-second 720p base generation.
Enable Motion Context and generate in segments while checking each join.
Apply built-in upscaling last so its artifacts do not confuse generation tuning.

zh: 最长时长和加速比例来自原帖版本快照，升级后需重新核验。
en: Maximum duration and speed claims are version snapshots; recheck after updates.

title.zh: 4070 12GB：5 秒分块续接 13 秒角色舞蹈
title.en: 4070 12GB: chain three five-second chunks into a character dance

outcome.zh: 在单次 13 秒无法生成时，用 Turbo 8 步与 Motion Context 分块完成。
outcome.en: When a 13-second pass does not fit, use eight-step Turbo and Motion Context chunks.

audience.zh: 12GB 显存、需要角色替换或长动作连续性的用户。
audience.en: 12GB users who need character replacement or longer motion continuity.

hardware.zh: RTX 4070 12GB + 32GB RAM（原帖实测）。
hardware.en: RTX 4070 12GB plus 32GB RAM, as reported by the source.

zh: Ref2VA 工作流
Turbo 8 步
Motion Context
动作参考视频
en: A Ref2VA workflow
Eight-step Turbo
Motion Context
A motion-reference video

zh: 把长动作切成三个约 5 秒区段。
用 Ref2VA 保持角色与动作参考，使用 8 步 Turbo 生成。
用 Motion Context 续接并检查动作、声音与身份边界。
en: Split the longer motion into roughly five-second sections.
Use Ref2VA for character and motion reference with eight-step Turbo.
Chain with Motion Context and inspect motion, audio, and identity at every join.

zh: 原帖约 30 分钟是单一硬件实测；分块重叠和接缝需要人工检查。
en: The roughly 30-minute time is hardware-specific; overlaps and joins require review.

title.zh: 4 步与 8 步 LoRA：用 30 秒续接做 A/B
title.en: Four-step vs eight-step LoRA: a 30-second chaining A/B

outcome.zh: 比较 lightx2v 与 larryvrh LoRA 在清晰度、噪声、语音和稳定性上的差异。
outcome.en: Compare lightx2v and larryvrh LoRAs for sharpness, noise, speech, and stability.

audience.zh: 已经能运行 Motion Context、正在选择 Turbo 权重的用户。
audience.en: Users with Motion Context working who are choosing a Turbo weight.

hardware.zh: 取决于 H3 WebUI 或 ComfyUI 当前路线。
hardware.en: Depends on the current H3 WebUI or ComfyUI path.

zh: 同一 Prompt、seed 与参考素材
两套待比较 LoRA
30 秒分段续接基线
en: The same prompt, seed, and references
Both LoRAs under test
A 30-second chained baseline

zh: 固定全部输入和 Motion Context 参数。
分别测试 4 步与 8 步，并记录 LoRA 强度。
从清晰度、噪声、语音与接缝稳定性四项选择，不只看速度。
en: Fix every input and Motion Context parameter.
Test four and eight steps separately and record LoRA strength.
Choose by sharpness, noise, speech, and join stability—not speed alone.

zh: 原作者结论属于其 WebUI 与当时权重版本，不能替代本机 A/B。
en: The source's conclusion reflects its WebUI and weight versions; it does not replace a local A/B.
